description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - pack sweep: packing a bag by feel leaves things behind, and you only notice at the destination. This agent turns packing into a visible coverage table: a preset list (ID, wallet, charger, medicine, keys, cup, clothes, umbrella) that you tick off item by item as you look at each thing and confirm it is packed, with a departure check that names every unpacked item and refuses to say you are ready until the list is fully packed. Packing is confirmed by your own actions (tap, row tap, steady nod) — this platform has no object recognition, so the agent never claims to know what is in the bag. Everything lives in session memory only and is wiped when the agent closes.
name: pack-sweep
